subject: Tenant wiring schedule, account bootstrap and ops ownership
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@helixhealth.io>
To: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-16T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: Tenant wiring schedule, account bootstrap and ops ownership

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team at Helix is excited to move forward. We want to capture the mutual action plan items that matter for us to get a small evaluation (staging tenant) up and running and to sign off within our quarter.

High-level asks we want included in the MAP:
- Org/tenant creation and admin invite (Helix SSO + SAML later)
- API key provisioning (ephemeral & service account keys): who generates, who rotates
- IP allowlist template for our staging VPC and CIDR ranges
- VPC peering: timeline and expected network steps (peering, routes, security groups)
- Data boundaries: what logs/metrics Redwood retains for the tenant

Can you share a proposed timeline for the above (we're aiming to close by 2027-06-10) and indicate any pre-reqs from our infra team? I attached a brief doc with our target CIDR and a spreadsheet for IP entries.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform, HelixHealth
marta@helixhealth.io

Attachments: ip-allowlist-template.csv

From: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@helixhealth.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant wiring schedule, account bootstrap and ops ownership

Marta — thanks, this is great. We're aligned on the checklist. Quick proposal below for MAP milestones and owners; this will help your infra team plan:

1) Org bootstrap + admin invite — owner: Dylan (accounts)
   - Redwood creates staging tenant and adds two Helix admin emails.
   - Estimated time: 24 hours after we receive final admin emails.
2) API keys & service accounts — owner: Ben (security)
   - We'll generate a service API key and provide a short-lived deployment key pattern.
   - Rotation / KMS integration notes: if you want KMS/HSM tied to keys, that's a follow-up.
   - Estimated time: 48 hours after tenant is provisioned.
3) IP allowlist — owner: Helix infra (Marta / Sam) with Redwood validation
   - Use attached template; we'll confirm CIDR formatting and edge NAT IPs.
   - Expected review cycle: same day once template submitted.
4) VPC peering — owner: Helix infra (primary) and Redwood infra (network)
   - We'll provide peering config and required firewall ports. Coordination call recommended.
   - Estimated time: 3 business days depending on cloud console access.
5) Final acceptance & signoff — owner: Marta (Helix) + Dylan (Redwood)
   - Validation by running a 1000-request smoke test and 1-hour load test.

Can Ben and I run a 30-minute technical sync with your infra folks today or tomorrow? I pasted a suggested slot below.

Proposed slots (PT): 2027-05-16 11:00 - 11:30, 14:00 - 14:30

I'll attach a draft MAP (for signatures) and the network checklist once Ben confirms the VPC steps.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@helixhealth.io>, dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-16T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant wiring schedule, account bootstrap and ops ownership

Marta / Dylan — adding a few technical specifics so your infra team can prework while we schedule the sync.

Network & peering checklist (summary):
- Peering mode: managed VPC peering (cross-account). We'll send the peering request from our side and you'll accept.
- Required ports: outbound 443 (TLS) to Redwood egress IPs; we'll provide the concrete list.
- Route propagation: disable automatic propagation for staging; we recommend route static entries for the peered subnet.
- NAT/egress: if your staging runs behind NAT, supply the NAT egress IPs so we can permit token callbacks.

API keys & auth:
- We'll create a service account 'helix-staging-svc' in the tenant and generate a one-time service key (JSON blob) you should import into your secrets manager.
- For ephemeral keys: we support a short-lived token flow (max 1 hour) you can use for CI tests.

Deliverables I'm attaching:
- MAP-draft-v1.pdf (action items + signoff)
- vpc-peering-checklist.xlsx (netops fields)

If the Helix infra lead can drop the cloud account IDs and at least two admin emails, we can start tenant provisioning today.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Infrastructure Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

> > Can Ben and I run a 30-minute technical sync with your infra folks today or tomorrow?

Thanks — we can do the 11:00 PT slot today. Confirming attendees from our side: Sam Park (cloud infra), Priya Shah (security) — Priya will review the MAP and attest around data boundaries.

We'll send the CIDR spreadsheet completed and our cloud account IDs in 30–60 minutes. Also, one question: for the service key JSON, would Redwood accept us importing the key into AWS Secrets Manager and then sharing ARN for the rotation workflow? Or do you require an uploaded key on Redwood side?

Looking forward to the call.

— Sam
